name: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report (arXiv:2412.19437)
notes: Primary source for DeepSeek-V3's vendor-stated figures: 671B total / 37B activated per token, MLA with kv_lora_rank 512 and q_lora_rank 1536, 256 routed + 1 shared expert with 8 active per token, first 3 layers dense, YaRN context extension.
